queries.sql: INSERT INTO apiome.version_content_counts AS r (version_id, content_stamp, class_count, class_property_count, max_class_created_at, counted_at) SELECT s.id, s.content_stamp, cc.class_count, cc.class_property_count, cc.max_class_created_at, now() FROM ( SELECT t.id, t.content_stamp FROM ( SELECT v.id, v.content_stamp FROM apiome.versions v JOIN apiome.projects p ON p.id = v.project_id WHERE p.tenant_id IN (SELECT tenant_id FROM apiome.tenant_users WHERE user_id = $1) UNION SELECT v.id, v.content_stamp FROM apiome.versions v WHERE v.creator_id = $1 ) t LEFT JOIN apiome.version_content_counts k ON k.version_id = t.id WHERE k.version_id IS NULL OR k.content_stamp <> t.content_stamp ORDER BY t.id OFFSET 0 ) s CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS class_count, COALESCE(SUM((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM apiome.class_properties cp WHERE cp.class_id = c.id)), 0)::int AS class_property_count, MAX(c.created_at) AS max_class_created_at FROM apiome.classes c WHERE c.version_id = s.id AND c.deleted_at IS NULL ) cc ON CONFLICT (version_id) DO UPDATE SET content_stamp = EXCLUDED.content_stamp, class_count = EXCLUDED.class_count, class_property_count = EXCLUDED.class_property_count, max_class_created_at = EXCLUDED.max_class_created_at, counted_at = EXCLUDED.counted_at

rs.version_pk JOIN apiome.projects p ON p.id = v.project_id JOIN apiome.tenants t ON t.id = p.tenant_id WHERE cp.name ILIKE $6 ESCAPE '\' LIMIT $2) ) m ), hits AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (hit_id) * FROM members ORDER BY hit_id, rank DESC ), page AS ( SELECT h.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY rank DESC, published_at DESC NULLS LAST, title ASC) AS ord FROM hits h ORDER BY rank DESC, published_at DESC
